document_editor.instructions: Edit the markdown below to create a custom document. Fields from Tab 1 are auto-populated using {{field}} placeholders. Dropbox Sign text tags (e.g. [sig|req|signer1]) become interactive signature fields. To add an image, use ![alt text](/filename.png) for a file in the public folder, or ![alt text](https://...) for a remote URL (PNG/JPEG only).
